prompt: A zone file contains `$ORIGIN example.com` and `host2.example.org. IN A 198.51.100.102`, and is included with `zone "example.com" { type master; file "db.example.com"; };`. Which problem is contained in this configuration?
choices: The zone cannot contain records for a name which is outside the zone's hierarchy
The zone statement must contain the `cross-zone-data yes;` statement
Names of records in a zone file cannot be fully qualified domain names
The `$ORIGIN` declaration cannot be used in zone files included for a specific zone name
An `A` record cannot contain an IPv4 address because its value must be a reverse DNS name
explanation: A zone for `example.com` may only hold records within the `example.com` hierarchy; `host2.example.org.` lies outside it and is rejected.
